description: Use when a patient, benefits manager, or procurement agent needs Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drugs transparent retail pricing for a specific NDC. Returns medication_name, brand_name, form, unit_price and unit_billing_price labeled transparent retail price estimate (cost+15% model), optional quantity quote, and canonical purchase URL — never labeled as a benchmark. Example: NDC 42385096230 — unit price $0.963 transparent retail price estimate (cost+15% model). Source: Cost Plus Drugs public API. | x402 SLA: $0.02 USDC per call. Returns HTTP 503 (no charge) when upstream data sources unavailable. data_sources[] discloses estimate provenance bound by synthesis.output_hash.
name: get_cost_plus_price
title: Get Cost Plus Price
